text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, it was so wonderful seeing you after so long.
Let's have lunch together again next time I'm back in the country.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So... is there anything troubling you, or anything you need?
It'll probably be a while until we can meet again.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, Mom! Actually...
There's a place I want to take you to...!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So this is Scarlet's classroom...
You study hard here every single day, don't you...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah! My seat is right where you can see the chalkboard—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Crap, I totally left my homework in my desk~!
Wait—Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka! Perfect timing.
Mom, this is my classmate Vodka.
I told you about her before, right? You know, my roommate...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Scarlet's mom! Nice to meetcha!
You here for a school tour?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. Hello, Vodka-chan.
Thank you for always looking after Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't mention it! ...Is what I'd like to say, but listen to this!
Just yesterday, this girl—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
!? You're not seriously gonna tell her *that* story, are you!?
Stop it! Why do you always have to be like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway! I'm with Mom right now!
Um, Mom, let's head to the next place!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: O-Okay...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: (I wonder how long it's been since I last saw Scarlet get so worked up like that...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm starving, Mom!
What do you want to eat? Should we go with something traditional from the menu?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sure.
Maybe I'll get the carrot hamburg steak.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
One carrot hamburg coming right up.
Oh! Scarlet-chan, we've got *that* today!
The "Ultra-Spicy Carrot Curry"!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me.
This child isn't very good with spicy food—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, Mom, it's fine, it's fine...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, you see... I kept ordering "whatever's the spiciest" and before I knew it, I fell in love with it. Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh my, is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet, today was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
R-Really? What a relief...
I invited you out of the blue, so I was worried if it'd be okay.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: Not at all! Seeing you living such a fulfilling life every day made Mom so incredibly happy!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...And also, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: I realized today just how little I know about who you are right now.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: How adorable you look when you're angry... and how much you love spicy food now.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: Because you always told me, "I'm fine, everything's fine," Mom felt relieved and ended up only thinking about work—

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Without realizing it, I turned into a parent you couldn't open up to about anything.

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text: So... do you have some free time tomorrow? I want you to tell me more about who you are now!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mom...! Yeah... Yeah, of course!
I want to talk with you a lot more, too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... but are you really okay on time, Mom? You said the project was tough...

text_block_list.name: Scarlet's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. Who do you think your mother is? I'll balance both flawlessly.
Now then, let's plan what we're going to do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I ran into Daiwa Scarlet.
She looked noticeably cheerful, so when I asked what was up—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, actually, Mom and I are going out together next time!
We're heading to a super spicy ramen shop and the most popular pancake place right now!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Mom told me, "I want you to take me to your favorite places"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My plan is to introduce all my favorite things and get even closer with Mom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As Daiwa Scarlet said that, her expression looked entirely bright and radiant.
